requirement.description: Memory signature validation messages don't match expected formats in WritePortTestCase and ReadPortTestCase. The error messages use f-string style formatting but the tests expect regex-style patterns.
requirement.contract: Update error message formatting in WritePort.Signature and ReadPort.Signature constructors to use consistent string formatting that matches test expectations. Specifically, fix the error messages for address width and granularity validation to match the expected regex patterns.

requirement.description: Unhashable types in switch/case handling cause TypeError when processing list keys. The Switch constructor attempts to hash keys but fails when keys are unhashable (like lists).
requirement.contract: Modify the Switch class to properly handle unhashable key types by converting them to hashable representations (strings) before using them as dictionary keys. Ensure all key types are properly converted to hashable form before being stored in the internal cases dictionary.

requirement.description: Missing end statements in RTLIL backend output cause test failures. The RTLIL emitter is not properly generating end statements for cells and processes.
requirement.contract: Ensure that all cell and process blocks in the RTLIL backend properly include end statements. Verify that the _Builder.cell() and _ProcessBuilder classes correctly emit the "end" statement for all constructs.
